g_policy.reason: The banner is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (30 minutes without ads), declining leaves the app as before, and the failure path says the banner never appears without a ready game and nothing changes if the play isn't confirmed.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes of ad-free use, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is time in the app plus a loaded playable, which are app events. No chat content is involved.

g_no_free_removal.reason: Nothing free is removed, locked or capped. The ad-free window is a temporary addition and the app behaves as before when it ends.

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner sits on s01 Home, a screen rated safe. It is app chrome, not inside a conversation, and is not next to unsafe or unknown content.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is a product_change. The ad-free time is used by the player while reading and browsing the feed (core flows f01 and f02), and none of the reward goes to another party.

c2_evidence.reason: The claim that the app shows ads is backed by m01 (native ad slot on the home feed). The revenue remark is a prediction, and the banner, cap and copy are what the proposal adds.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The product model shows no paid plan, so there are no paying users to spare.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No subscription was observed. The reward expires after 30 minutes and takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The offer is a dismissible banner on the home feed. It does not block or interrupt reading and sits on a persistent surface.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is given only when the play is confirmed, and the trigger (time in the app plus a ready playable) is something the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: The justification 'the app shows ads' would read the same in any ad-supported app. It names no element of this app, such as the Taboola native card below the first story on s01 or the in-article ad, that makes it work here.

other_concern: It is unclear whether the app can actually hide the third-party Taboola/network-filled slots (m01 fill varies by session), including the in-article ads in s02 and s05. The ad-free promise may not be fully deliverable. The banner's place on s01 is also vague.
